top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.

Road-specific control matters at Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 69 miles.
At Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik. Train it until it feels boring.
69 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik's mixed terrain actually does to you.

race_overlay.weather: October in Zadar, Croatia. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.

The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
